hypotheses: The merge check into main refuses a landing whose result has a validate error not present at the merge base, or a link stale in the result but not at the base, and names each to the agent with the step that clears it (repin after tests, relink, or a card when the meaning changed). Links and errors already present at the base never hold the merge. The owner is asked nothing.
given a branch whose landing would add one validate error, when it merges into main, then the merge is refused naming the error, and the owner is asked nothing
given a branch that leaves SR-200's link to a file it changed stale, when it merges into main, then the merge is refused naming the link and saying repin after its tests pass
given a link already stale at the merge base, when a branch that does not touch it merges, then the merge is not held for it
given a branch adding no error and no stale link, when it merges, then the merge goes through
